name: AI-BS Genomic & Telemetry Processing Flex Template
description: High-throughput Apache Beam Dataflow pipeline for cleaning, validating, and aggregating genomic variants and inference telemetry.

parameters.name: input_pattern
parameters.label: Input File Pattern
parameters.helpText: GCS path pattern for raw genomic or telemetry JSONL files (e.g., gs://aibs-vault-data/genomics/*.jsonl)

parameters.name: output_table
parameters.label: Output BigQuery Table
parameters.helpText: BigQuery destination table in PROJECT:DATASET.TABLE format

parameters.name: output_gcs_prefix
parameters.label: Output GCS Prefix
parameters.helpText: GCS prefix for aggregated gene summary JSONL reports (e.g., gs://aibs-vault-data/summaries/gene_run)

parameters.name: dead_letter_path
parameters.label: Dead Letter GCS Path
parameters.helpText: GCS path for recording malformed or unparseable variant records
